title: Here's where I got to with one month of Claude Max.
author: rutan668
selftext:
Why a bunch of images rather than the Claude artefact it came from?  That would be because ending a Claude subscription ends your access to Claude code - all the chats and all the artefacts!  All gone.  If Claude could have made me money I could have paid to continue the Claude Max subscription, but it wasn't to be.  BTW this is an older version of the artefact which I luckily used to create a PDF from.  The open stuff is now closed.  
  
I didn't make it but I thought I got close and if you can use it to help you on your journey and you make it then have a thought for me when you're sipping a martini on your private jet.
